state_reference.bioregion_levels_rule: lexicographically sorted exact observed bioregion labels; Afrotropical is the fixed baseline if present

transforms.LOG_AREA: natural log of Area; Area must be finite and strictly positive

state_reference.numeric_standardization: population mean and population SD over all exact 5592 safe islands; zero/nonfinite SD is STOP

source_operator.source_unit: the exact 219 response-independent validation blocks frozen in v1.26
source_operator.block_centroid: equal-island spherical mean of unit vectors from safe island centroid coordinates; convert back to latitude/longitude
source_operator.graph: symmetrized k-nearest-neighbor graph over 219 block centroids
source_operator.k_rule: smallest integer k >= 1 for which the symmetrized graph is connected
source_operator.kernel_scale_rule: Hyndman-Fan type-7 median of positive selected graph edge lengths
source_operator.all_pairs_block_shortest_paths: deterministic Dijkstra from every block; stored as hexadecimal km values keyed by block_id pairs

later_training_only_source_semantics.heldout_exclusion: remove the entire target validation block before every occupancy/source feature is computed
R3_must_include: Jeffreys global occupancy logit over training islands
Jeffreys species_x_bioregion occupancy logit over training islands in target bioregion
nearest occupied source-block direct distance from target island to source-block centroid
diffuse occupied source-block pressure weighted by source-block training prevalence using the frozen kernel scale
C_adds_only: nearest occupied source-block graph-path distance between target block and occupied source blocks
graph-path occupied source-block pressure weighted by source-block training prevalence using the frozen kernel scale

primary_macro_estimand.block_weighting: equal weight across confirmatory validation blocks
primary_macro_estimand.extreme_current_isolation_role: predeclared secondary context using the v1.26 frozen Q75; may not rescue the overall macro primary
